findings.premise: chat-panel.ts handleMessage has a default/else branch that currently drops (leaves unimplemented) the sc3 set-edit-mode and edit-decision messages, which S006 will fill.
findings.evidence: handleMessage at chat-panel.ts:267; its switch default (chat-panel.ts:312-315) is an accepted-but-ignored seam whose comment literally reads 'set-edit-mode (S006), edit-decision (S006), docs-decision (S007) ... never an error'. S006 filling those cases is exactly the reserved extension point. Sound.

findings.premise: The sc3 protocol (protocol.ts) already declares HostToWebview edit-prompt and WebviewToHost set-edit-mode + edit-decision, so S006 needs no sc3 shape change.
findings.evidence: protocol.ts declares edit-prompt (line 37), set-edit-mode (46), edit-decision (47) plus their type-name arrays (55/64/65). All three sc3 messages S006 rides already exist; no sc3 shape change needed. Sound.

findings.premise: ChatSession.editMode ('auto'|'review') already exists on the sc4 store shape and defaults to 'auto' at create(), so S006 only reads/writes it (no store shape change).
findings.evidence: session-store.ts:29 declares editMode: 'auto' | 'review' on ChatSession; create() defaults it to 'auto' (confirmed earlier at :151, and the test fixture session-store.test.ts:154 uses editMode:'auto'). S006 only reads/writes it — no store shape change. Sound.

findings.premise: The sc2 adapter maps codex file_change/patch to a file-edit with EMPTY hunks and claude Edit/Write via diffFromClaudeEdit, so S006 cannot rely on the sc2 diff payload and computes its own diff.
findings.evidence: cli-adapter.ts:217 maps codex file_change/patch and cli-adapter.ts:219 emits file-edit with hunks:[] (EMPTY); claude Edit/Write go via diffFromClaudeEdit (cli-adapter.ts:114/168). So the sc2 diff payload is unreliable for render, exactly as the LLD premises — S006 computing its own diff is justified. Sound.

findings.premise: createChatPanelHost is a vscode-free deps-injected factory (all vscode via the injected ChatPanelChannel seam), so S006 adds its governance seams as new injected deps.
findings.evidence: createChatPanelHost at chat-panel.ts:61 with the doc 'All vscode calls are injected via ChatPanelChannel' (chat-panel.ts:11) and ChatPanelHostDeps as the deps type; vscode-free deps-injection confirmed. S006 adding governance seams as new injected deps fits. Sound.

findings.premise: The sc1 SurfaceKind union already includes 'inline-diff', the surface S006's chat-view diff renders under; S006 does not modify design-tokens.ts.
findings.evidence: design-tokens.ts:29 SurfaceKind union includes 'inline-diff'; SURFACE_KINDS (:36) + TERMINAL_SURFACE_CLASS['inline-diff']='insrc-term-diff' (:45) already provide the surface class. S006 consumes it and does not modify design-tokens.ts. Sound.

findings.premise: insrc.chat.diffView is a NEW plugin-local setting (not yet present); it follows the insrc.chat.enabled precedent of a package.json contributes.configuration key read via getConfiguration().get with the full dotted key.
findings.evidence: grep -c insrc.chat.diffView in vscode-plugin/package.json = 0 (only appears in DEF/LLD docs), confirming it is genuinely NEW. The precedent insrc.chat.enabled is read at extension.ts:416 via getConfiguration().get<boolean>('insrc.chat.enabled') with the full dotted key (matching :184). S006 following that idiom for diffView is accurate. Sound.

api.name: createEditGovernor

parameters.name: deps
parameters.purpose: Injected vscode-free seams: { baseline: WorkspaceBaseline; fs: FsSeam; computeDiff; render: EditRenderSeam; diffView: () => 'chat' | 'editor' }.

returns.meaning: S006-private vscode-free governor holding per-turn state (mode, baseline?, edits Map) in memory only (k3). Renders every edit as a diff (ac1); in review mode gates accept/reject with pre-turn-snapshot revert (ac2).

errors.condition: Seam failures are caught and degrade (missing baseline -> visualize-only); never throws into the turn loop.

preconditions: Constructed once per host; beginTurn precedes observe/resolveTurn per turn.
postconditions: No direct vscode refs; nothing new persisted.

api.name: EditGovernor.beginTurn

parameters.name: input
parameters.purpose: The session editMode (sc4) + workspace root at turn start.

returns.meaning: Captures the pre-turn baseline before the CLI can write (deps.baseline.snapshot); non-git -> no-baseline (visualize-only).

errors.condition: snapshot failure -> no-baseline mode; never blocks the turn.

preconditions: Called immediately before adapter.run() so the snapshot predates any CLI write.
postconditions: A baseline handle (or no-baseline flag) + empty edits map are ready.

api.name: EditGovernor.observe

parameters.name: path
parameters.purpose: The path from an sc2 file-edit event (the signal a path changed this turn).

returns.meaning: First observe per path: reads baseline + current disk content, computes the diff itself (independent of sc2.diff; correct for codex empty-hunks + claude MultiEdit) and renders via deps.render per diffView(). Auto: visualize-only (ac1); review: track undecided.

errors.condition: read/compute failure logs + skips that path; the turn continues.

postconditions: The edit is visible as a diff; in review mode the path is tracked.

api.name: EditGovernor.resolveTurn

returns.meaning: Turn-end (sc2 done/error): auto = no-op; review = surface accept/reject per undecided path; resolves when all decided or superseded/disposed.

errors.condition: prompt failure / dispose mid-review leaves edits kept + clears state; never throws.

preconditions: beginTurn + zero-or-more observe happened this turn.
postconditions: Edits map cleared; no file modified except via an explicit reject.

api.name: EditGovernor.decide

parameters.name: path
parameters.purpose: Path from an sc3 edit-decision or the editor affordance.

parameters.name: accept
parameters.purpose: true keeps disk; false reverts to the pre-turn baseline.

returns.meaning: accept keeps; reject restores the path's pre-turn baseline via deps.fs.write (or git checkout of the baseline object). Reject with no baseline is a no-op with a surfaced note.

errors.condition: revert write failure logs + surfaces; does not throw.

preconditions: path was tracked by observe in review mode this turn (unknown path ignored).
postconditions: On reject with a baseline, the file equals its pre-turn state; path marked decided.

api.name: handleMessage

parameters.name: message
parameters.purpose: sc3 WebviewToHost envelope; S006 fills the reserved default-case set-edit-mode + edit-decision (chat-panel.ts:313).

returns.meaning: set-edit-mode: set session.editMode (validated) + store.save (sc4; S005 title-persist pattern) + re-render toggle. edit-decision: forward to governor.decide. Malformed payloads keep the existing drop-with-warn.

errors.condition: non-'auto'/'review' mode or non-string path dropped (typeof guard).

preconditions: Called from the single onMessage handler.
postconditions: editMode persists per session (ac3); decisions reach the governor.

api.name: createChatPanelHost

parameters.name: deps
parameters.purpose: Existing deps extended with OPTIONAL editGovernance seams (baseline/fs/editorDiff) + diffView accessor; absent -> today's marker-only behavior.

returns.meaning: Turn loop reshaped: governor.beginTurn before adapter.run, observe(path) per file-edit, resolveTurn on the terminal event; the marker-row render (S004/S008) is unchanged.

preconditions: extension.ts injects real vscode-backed seams (git baseline, fs, vscode.diff) + a diffView accessor reading insrc.chat.diffView.
postconditions: Existing construction without the new deps still works (marker-only).

api.name: EditRenderSeam
api.signature: interface EditRenderSeam { showChat(path: string, diff: UnifiedDiff, opts: { review: boolean }): void; showEditor(path: string, baseline: string | undefined, opts: { review: boolean }): Promise<void>; }

parameters.name: (type)
parameters.purpose: Injected render seam for the two surfaces (ac4): showChat posts the sc3 edit-prompt (webview, sc1-styled); showEditor opens native vscode.diff.

returns.meaning: Keeps the governor vscode-free; chat rides sc3, editor rides injected vscode APIs (no protocol change).

postconditions: Chat diff stays in the one nonce'd CSP script; editor uses native diff, no webview.

errorCases.scenario: Non-git workspace / git unavailable, so no exact pre-turn baseline at beginTurn.
errorCases.detection: deps.baseline.available(cwd) false or snapshot() rejects; beginTurn catches and sets a no-baseline flag.
errorCases.response: Degrade to visualize-only; review accept/reject disabled with a surfaced note; no throw.
errorCases.userImpact: Diffs still shown; revert unavailable in a non-git folder; auto unaffected.

errorCases.detection: deps.fs.write (or git checkout) rejects inside decide(); caught.
errorCases.response: Log + surface an error note for that path; leave disk as-is; mark decided so resolveTurn completes; never throw.
errorCases.userImpact: That file not reverted; user told; other paths unaffected.

errorCases.scenario: An edited path is binary/non-UTF8 so a text line-diff is meaningless.
errorCases.detection: computeDiff / fs read detects non-text (null bytes / decode failure).
errorCases.response: Render a 'binary file changed' row; review accept/reject still works via whole-file baseline restore.
errorCases.userImpact: User sees the change + can accept/reject without a garbled diff.

errorCases.scenario: An edit-decision arrives for an untracked/already-decided path (stale/duplicate click).
errorCases.detection: governor.decide finds the path absent or already decided in the edits map.

alternativesConsidered.name: Git turn-start tree snapshot + extension-computed diff + injected chat/editor render seams
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Capture an exact working-tree baseline via git at turn start; compute the diff baseline-vs-current and render it (chat or editor per insrc.chat.diffView); reject restores the path from the baseline.
alternativesConsidered.approach: EditGovernor holds per-turn state; at turn start an injected workspaceBaseline seam snapshots the working tree (git write-tree/stash-create style, no working-tree disturbance). On each file-edit it reads baseline + current via an fs seam and computes a UnifiedDiff itself (independent of sc2.diff). diffView() routes to the chat webview (sc3 edit-prompt) or a native vscode.diff seam. Auto = visualize-only; review = per-path accept/reject with baseline revert. Non-git degrades to visualize-only. sc2/sc3/sc4 unchanged; only S006-private injected deps + a plugin-local setting.
pros: Exact pre-turn baseline -> faithful revert (ac2); matches accuracy-first
Provider-symmetric + fixes sc2 gaps (codex empty hunks, claude MultiEdit/Write) without reshaping sc2
One baseline feeds ac1 + ac2 + both surfaces (ac4); nothing persisted
cons: Needs a git repo for revert fidelity; non-git falls back to visualize-only
A per-turn git snapshot + a git-shell seam; several baselines held until decided on heavy turns
Two new injected seams enlarge the deps surface

alternativesConsidered.name: Lazy per-file disk snapshot at the file-edit event (git-independent)
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: No turn-start baseline; on first file-edit for a path copy current disk content into memory and diff/revert against that.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Same governor/render/wiring as a1 but the baseline is captured lazily at the file-edit event via the fs seam. No git. Under k8 the CLI may have already written by the time we observe, so the captured baseline can be post-write.
pros: No git dependency; works in any folder
cons: Revert fidelity not guaranteed: a write landing before the snapshot yields a post-write baseline -> weakens ac2
Cannot reliably provide before-content for a faithful diff
alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: The k8 observer timing makes the baseline racy: ac2 only partial. A good non-git FALLBACK for a1, not the primary.

alternativesConsidered.name: Reconstruct the baseline from the sc2 diff payload (no snapshot)
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Reverse-apply the sc2 file-edit diff (claude old_string) to reconstruct/rollback; store nothing.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Rely entirely on sc2's diff: claude Edit carries old_string so the pre-edit fragment can be reverse-applied. Render/routing/wiring as a1.
pros: Zero new persistence, no git, no snapshot bookkeeping
For a single claude Edit the diff is already in hand
cons: Fails for codex (empty hunks) -> ac2/ac4 unmet for codex
Fails for claude Write (no old) + MultiEdit/NotebookEdit (unparsed)
Couples S006 to sc2 internals (owned by s2); adapter changes silently break revert
alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: Violates ac2 and couples to sc2 internals: codex + claude Write/MultiEdit have no reconstructable baseline. Cannot deliver for both providers.
